Synopsis:
CRD for Shadowheart on the Enemy of Shar Path inviting the avatar to a romance scene. Shadowheart is feeling vulnerable after defying her goddess and being declared a heretic. She's now enemy to her former kin, and has been 'marked' (inflicted with so much pain by Shar that her her has partially turned white). Now she concorts a plan to restore some autonomy

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_Shadowheart_CRD_SkinnyDippingRomance.json: Shadowheart has openly defied Shar, been declared a heretic and enemy of her former kin, and bears Shar’s mark—a physical and psychic wound that leaves her feeling unclean and vulnerable. She’s determined to reclaim some autonomy and has come up with a private, intimate plan: a late‑night trip down the coast to swim and symbolically “wash off” Shar’s influence. You are a trusted companion (and potential romantic partner) she asks to join her after the others are asleep, so your prior support or refusal will shape her response. Separately, Ferg the Sharran informer is Shadowheart’s external contact and may play into larger power moves later, but this scene is focused on a personal, restorative moment rather than political scheming.
- END_GameFinale_RomanceFates_Shadowheart.json: Shadowheart and her love interest player talk in a private bedroom in an inn, the morning after spending the night together after saving the world. A discussion of what comes next ensues, varying depending on how Shadowheart's story unfolded. She could:- have remained committed to Shar and have sacrificed her parents. She is now in charge of Shar's church.- she could have abandoned Shar at the last moment and saved her parents- she could have turned from Shar in Act 2, and set out on a mission to save her parents in Act 3, rescuing them- she could have turned from Shar in Act 2, and set out on a mission to save her parents in Act 3, but instead euthanized them to free them from Shar's curse.- none of the above are applicable, and she is aware she has unfinished (and undefined) business she needs to tend to.
- CAMP_Shadowheart_CRD_SharedFuture.json: Shadowheart is back in her 'home city' but doesn't really remember much of it. With the player's help/tag reactivity (baldurian inside info etc), they discuss a future they could have together. Forget the obstacles ahead for a while and dream of what post-victory life might be like (foreshadow romance fate)
- EPI_Epilogue_Shadowheart.json: Speaking to Shadowheart at a reunion of all the companions six months after the Absolute was defeated. The circumstances under which the player is speaking to her differ depending on prior events - they could be lovers who have been spending the past while together, or they could be platonic and have not seen eachother in a while. There are variants for Shadowheart's overall arc also - if she sided with Shar or not, saved her parents or not etc.
- LOW_SharGrotto_ParentsFate_OM_Shadowheart_COM.json: Shadowheart meets with her parents once again, who have been imprisoned for decades. A vision of Shar appears and demands Shadowheart sacrifice her parents.Note: there are two major tracks in this scene - if SH comes to it as a loyal Sharran who is intent on taking control of the church at her goddess's command, or as someone who has turned from Shar and is coming to rescue her parents.

context: Shadowheart has openly defied Shar and been declared a heretic and enemy of her former kin, bearing Shar’s mark — a physical and psychic wound (her hair partly turned white and a constant, shameful pain) that leaves her feeling unclean and raw. She’s determined to reclaim some autonomy and has conceived a private, intimate plan: a late‑night walk down the coast to swim and symbolically “wash off” Shar’s influence. You are a trusted companion and possible romantic partner she asks to join after the others are asleep, so whatever you say now will shape how vulnerable or resolute she becomes. This moment is meant as a personal, restorative gesture rather than a political maneuver (Ferg the Sharran informer figures elsewhere in her story but not in this scene), and she even admits she can’t swim yet — learning to do so is part of taking back control.
